rule: Each entry is a place where the build deliberately differs from an approved image. The treatment is always the smallest layout-preserving change: the slot, its size and its typographic role stay; only the untrue or unsafe content changes.

mediaParity.why: No authorised image-generation provider is configured (Higgsfield needs an interactive sign-in; the fal.ai token is rejected; no generation budget was authorised). The couple portraits and the edge botanicals are therefore clean crops of the approved generated imagery at the mockups' native resolution, upscaled 1.25-2.6x, and every one is marked interim: true in public/media/botanical-deco/manifest.json. media-briefs.md holds the exact briefs for the final high-resolution replacements; swapping them in is a manifest change.
